targetingPriority: Elites first — punch through barricades faster; Vanguard Turret auto-focuses them.
Group clears second — Demolitionist Shockwave/Molotov and Necromancer Death Nova want tight packs.
Single-target stragglers last — Marksman Deadeye pierce between waves.

classCounters.summary: Vanguard Turret auto-targets elites. Steel Barricades funnel packs into kill zones. Turrets ignore Necromancer minions (patched Feb 2026).
Soul Harvest banks fuel from kills; Raise Undead converts corpses; Death Nova detonates minion stack. Minion kills credit player (patched Feb 2026). Buffed May 8, 2026.
Shockwave Bomb stuns grouped charges before barricade contact. Molotov for area denial. Not ideal for fast single-target elites.
Deadeye pierce through corridor lines. Sonar Ping pre-marks elites. Recommended first serious unlock for DPS.
Bunker gives squad invincibility + regen + damage boost. Laser Turret and Drones add range and damage sponge layers.
Stim Shot, Mending Tower, Healing Station maintain HP between waves. Earns Credits from healing players and structures (Feb 2026 patch).

waveDensity.summary: Sparse standard spawns. Bank Credits; place chokepoint before Auto Skip. AoE abilities overkill here.
Packs form; elites mix in. Ensure Vanguard Turret or Sonar Ping active. New movement uses stairwell ramps on Rooftop Map.
Most of 500+ total count. Elites + packs at high density. Necromancer Death Nova and Bastion Bunker peak here.

faq.question: How many zombies per run?
faq.answer: Public guides describe 500+ enemies per session. Density increases with wave counter — concentrated in mid and late phases.

faq.question: Are there bosses?
faq.answer: Boss-tier encounters not documented in tracked third-party sources. Check official Discord for announcements.

faq.question: What are elite zombies?
faq.answer: Hardier spawns that punch through barricades faster. Tactician Vanguard Turret auto-prioritizes them. More frequent from mid waves onward.

faq.question: Best class against packs?
faq.answer: Demolitionist for mid-wave packs (Shockwave + Molotov). Necromancer Death Nova outscales in late-wave maximum density.

faq.question: What is VOLATILE?
faq.answer: Upcoming named zombie previewed by Santito in Discord #sneak-peeks (Feb 2026). Not live as of May 2026. Only name and distinct movement confirmed.
